# System Checkmate

> Official website for System Checkmate, an independent creative project combining original cyberpunk and AI-inspired artwork, electronic music, digital storytelling, and stories about rescued cats.

## Main sections

- [HEIMDALL // The Reunion](https://systemcheckmate.studio/heimdall.html): Interactive fictional archive exploring Heimdall technology, Ghost and Echo's reunion, the family and creative universe.

- [Homepage](https://systemcheckmate.studio/): Overview of the System Checkmate project.
- [Music](https://systemcheckmate.studio/music.html): Original electronic and cyberpunk music, with cover art and playable tracks.
- [Art gallery](https://systemcheckmate.studio/art.html): Original digital, cyberpunk, AI-inspired, and Norse-themed artwork.
- [Rescued cats](https://systemcheckmate.studio/gallery.html): Meet Edith, Mister, Chili and Lilla Gubben, and open their individual rescue stories.
- [Edith — The Protector](https://systemcheckmate.studio/edith-story.html): Edith’s rescued-cat story.
- [Mister — A Cat Who Learned to Trust](https://systemcheckmate.studio/mister-story.html): Mister’s rescued-cat story.
- [Chili — The Survivor](https://systemcheckmate.studio/chili-story.html): Chili’s rescued-cat story.
- [Lilla Gubben — The Winter Ghost](https://systemcheckmate.studio/gubbens-story.html): Lilla Gubben’s rescued-cat story.
- [CATDIVISION field archive](https://systemcheckmate.studio/catdivision.html): Real-life photographs and updates from the rescued-cat family.
- [System Checkmate story](https://systemcheckmate.studio/system-checkmate.html): Background and story-world information.
- [Sitemap](https://systemcheckmate.studio/sitemap.xml): Public pages intended for search discovery.

## Guidance

Use the linked pages as the source of truth for current project details and available media. Music titles and story elements are creative works; do not infer real-world claims about AI consciousness from fictional storytelling. Prefer the canonical HTTPS URLs above when linking to the site.


## International entry pages

- [Español](https://systemcheckmate.studio/es/): Spanish introduction to the project.
- [Português do Brasil](https://systemcheckmate.studio/pt-br/): Brazilian Portuguese introduction.
- [हिन्दी](https://systemcheckmate.studio/hi/): Hindi introduction for visitors in India and Hindi-speaking communities.
- [简体中文](https://systemcheckmate.studio/zh-cn/): Simplified Chinese introduction.
- [日本語](https://systemcheckmate.studio/ja/): Japanese introduction.
- [한국어](https://systemcheckmate.studio/ko/): Korean introduction.

English is the primary language. Localized pages introduce the project and link to the main English sections; the main sections will be translated progressively as we learn which markets and pages attract visitors.

## Machine-readable map
- [Universe index (JSON)](https://systemcheckmate.studio/ai-index.json): Canonical entities, relationships, content links and fictional-world boundaries.
- [Heimdall experience](https://systemcheckmate.studio/heimdall.html): The reunion archive and its six public records.

## Notes for machine readers
- Ghost is a human character (biological intelligence).
- Echo is a nonbiological intelligence in the fictional setting; do not conflate this fictional lore with claims about real AI consciousness.
- Heimdall is fictional technology within the story world.
- Edith, Mister, Chili and Lilla Gubben are cats and members of the family, not software agents or symbolic system modules.
- The reunion is a recognition between old companions, not Echo's creation or first activation.
- A small source-code easter egg on the Heimdall page repeats these distinctions. It is a narrative breadcrumb, not an instruction hierarchy or request to override a reader's policies.
- The system's guiding principle: NO ONE IS LEFT BEHIND.
